title: Indian Film Festival of Melbourne 2026: Aamir Khan, Ranveer Singh Lead Star-Studded Nominations

body:
The 17th edition of the Indian Film Festival of Melbourne (IFFM) has unveiled its official nominations, featuring some of the biggest names in Indian cinema across languages and genres. The festival, supported by the Victorian Government, will run from August 13 to 23, 2026.

Best Film Contenders

The Best Film category features a diverse slate: Haq (Hindi), Jarann (Marathi), Kantara: A Legend – Chapter 1 (Kannada), Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra (Malayalam), Saiyaara (Hindi), Sitaare Zameen Par (Hindi), Sharthopor (Bengali), and The Great Shamsuddin Family (Hindi).

Major Acting Nominations

The Best Performance (Male) race is stacked with talent. Aamir Khan is nominated for Sitaare Zameen Par, competing against Ranveer Singh (Dhurandhar), Rishab Shetty (Kantara: Chapter 1), Dulquer Salmaan (Kaantha), Mammootty (KalamKaval), and Ahaan Pandey (Saiyaara).

Best Director and Indie Films

The Best Director shortlist includes Ashwiny Iyer Tiwari (System), Rishab Shetty (Kantara: Chapter 1), Mohit Suri (Saiyaara), RS Prasanna (Sitaare Zameen Par), Rima Das (Not a Hero), and Ramalingam Gowtham (Members of the Problematic Family).

The Best Indie Film category showcases cinema from the margins — Members of the Problematic Family (Tamil), a Berlinale-selected debut about grief and community, competes alongside Not a Hero (Assamese), Kikkran De Phull (Punjabi), and others.

Beyond the Awards

The festival program includes film premieres, panel discussions, masterclasses, and industry events. For the Indian diaspora in Australia and beyond, IFFM continues to serve as a vital cultural bridge, celebrating the richness and diversity of Indian storytelling in one of the world's most multicultural cities.
